question: Fetch https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html with the WebFetch tool and return the full text content of the page, verbatim, with no summary.
response_text:
I couldn't retrieve the GPL-3.0 text. I called WebFetch three times and gnu.org returned HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) each time, with a `Retry-After: 4` header. Two of those calls were to the URL you gave. The third was to the plain-text version, `https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt`. I retried right away each time, without a real 4-second pause, so the server may still have been throttling me.

I don't want to reproduce the license from memory. You asked for the text verbatim, and a recalled copy of a document this long could have small errors.

You could ask me to try again in a moment, since the rate limit may have cleared. Or you could get it directly with `curl -O https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt`. If you'd like, I can also try another official mirror, such as the copy on spdx.org or the one in the GitHub licenses repo.
